question: Can balancing only the original article h1 remove very short last lines without changing type size, text, viewport width or adding title height in the named short-heading cases?
decisionChangingEvidence: Original real headings compared in the same settled-font page and same DOM at paired A/B natural frames; per-character Range line groups and full screenshots. Prefer B only when last-line distribution improves without overflow or added heading height. A real long title beyond engine line limit is a limitation case, not a forced pass.
smallestFailure: Text/type identity or width changes, horizontal overflow, added heading height >0.5CSSpx, or no improvement in the known one-character orphan case.
stopRule: Three original-content cases once per A/B; preserve all outcomes, stop without production edits or tuning to a preferred result.

references.basis: balance is intended for short headings; engines limit affected line counts. Do not apply the slower pretty strategy to the full body or claim unsupported browsers verified.
